The older structures are located near the water's edge, adjacent to the canal.

perception.description: Aerial view showing a canal bank adjacent to older single-story buildings and a large vegetable garden. The zoomed-in evidence reveals a pile of mixed debris and trash on the ground near the water, alongside a small blue boat moored in the canal. Solar panels are visible on a nearby roof.
